## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4056fd97b37bee1ff3517c09b285b4529581b051`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts (`WriteWarningEvent`, `readWriteNotice`, `notifyDroppedFields`), ui/packages/react/src/record-save-feedback.ts (`AnswerWarningsEvent`, `RecordSaveFeedback`, `AnswerWarningClaim.take`, `RecordSaveSink`, `toastRecordSave`), ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.ts (`WriteWarningSink`, `emitWriteWarning`, `emitAnswerFeedback`), ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx (`crud_success`, `handleCrudSuccess`, the child-form branch), ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.tsx (`handleSuccess`), ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectFormContainer.tsx (`useContainerSaveFeedback`), ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx (`defaultRowSave`, `defaultBatchSave`, `saveRowsClaimed`), the eight test files, .changeset/28252-save-toast-hook-notice.md + packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts (the single-record write answers' `notice`, `z.string().min(1).optional()`, :2692 and :2875), ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/AdapterProvider.tsx (the one `emitWriteWarning` caller, sonner's `toast` as the sink), ui/packages/react/src/index.ts (the `record-save-feedback` barrel line), .changeset/28216-form-container-one-save-toast.md on `main` (the #28267 entry, still pending)

Inputs: card #28252 (body and all five comments: triage 6532337619 with the one-toast rule, the unblock 6533319341, the seat's claim 6538004798, the dev report 6538812279, the claim amendment 6538826704 which flips Clause-② to widening, accepts `ObjectGrid.tsx` on the surface and asks the lane to check the two reshaped `@object-ui/react` signatures), PR #28307 (body with its surface table, the file list of 15 files, the diff of 1147 lines against `main` read whole, the commits from merge-base 6285203d), the 60 check-runs on this head (read 2026-10-31T04:24Z: all 60 runs completed, none failed, none cancelled, none in progress; success: Build & E2E UI, Build UI Deps, Check Changeset, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint UI, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Test Core, Test UI, Test UI (all 16), Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · workspace, TypeScript Type Check, filter; skipped: 18.x upgrade harness (opt-in), Auto Label, Build Core, Build Docs, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix shard/3), Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in), Plan Test Core shards, Schedule gate · skip when a green push run covers the commit, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), Test Core (matrix shard/8), UI Published Artifacts), and the tree at this head and on `main` for the items the Scope line names. The head is mergeable and clean against today's `main` (merge-tree clean); none of the files `main` moved since the merge-base is in this diff.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The adapter now carries the answer's `notice`** - right. `readWriteNotice` answers the key only as a non-empty string, which is exactly the spec's `z.string().min(1).optional()`, so an answer from a runtime that predates the key adds nothing. `notifyDroppedFields` emits when any of dropped fields, warnings or notice is present and spreads `notice` onto the event only when set; what `create` and `update` resolve is unchanged. The batch path is untouched, matching the spec, which declares `notice` on the single-record answers only.
- **One toast per write, on every surface the body's table names** - right. The channel parks when the event carries warnings or a notice, still before its first `await`, so the claim holds the feedback by the time the surface's success handler runs. `take` returns `{ warnings, notice? }` with the last parked notice winning (the server's `onNotice` rule); `toastRecordSave` keeps the surface's message as the title, puts the notice then the warnings under it, and picks the warning variant only when a warning is present. `AppContent` (the `crud_success` params carry `notice` beside `warnings`, and the child-form branch passes the feedback), `RecordFormPage` and `ObjectFormContainer` hand `take`'s result through. `ObjectGrid` opens an `update` claim for the row before `writeRowGuarded` and reads it into its one "saved" toast after the refresh; "Save All" opens one claim per id, reads every claim once into a single toast (distinct warnings, distinct notices one per line), and releases in `finally`. A row that reloaded or failed wrote nothing, so its claim parks nothing.
- **An unclaimed write still gets one toast** - right. `emitAnswerFeedback` is the old `emitAnswerWarnings` with the notice leading the warnings lines, or an `info` toast of its own when there are no warnings; nothing when there is neither. `WriteWarningSink.info` is satisfied by sonner's `toast`, the only sink `AdapterProvider` passes, and the sink type is not on the app-shell barrel. The stripped-fields toast is unchanged.
- **The claim's `take(undefined)` from the grid** - safe. For an `update` scope every parked event is the claim's own (the scope names the id), so the `saved` argument is read only for creates, which the grid never makes.
- **Accept-set: nothing an author writes moves** - right. No spec changes; `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.
- **Check-runs as gate verdicts** - read as above; every run on this head completed and none is red, cancelled or in progress at the read.

### ② Semver level

- **`@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` all patch; `Clause-②: yes (widening)`; `Metadata-protocol: none`** - accepted. `WriteWarningEvent.notice` is an optional field; `RecordSaveFeedback` is an additive type export; the event firing for a notice-only answer is new behaviour a subscriber could not have observed before.
- **The two reshaped signatures the seat asked the lane to check** - not a narrowing of anything released. `AnswerWarningClaim.take` (`string[]` to `RecordSaveFeedback`) and `toastRecordSave`'s third argument (`readonly string[]` to a `Partial` of `RecordSaveFeedback`) both first landed in #28267 (`ba5c754d`, 2026-10-30), whose changeset `.changeset/28216-form-container-one-save-toast.md` is still pending on `main` at this read, so no published `@object-ui/react` carries the old shape and the two ship together as additive exports. `RecordSaveSink.success` gaining an optional `options` argument is a widening of a structural type sonner already satisfies. If a Version Packages release were cut between #28267 and this PR the reading would change; the seat lands this before that happens or re-states the changeset.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **The record page's inline-edit Save bar raises no save toast of its own** - so its notice arrives as the channel's info toast, which is still one toast per write. Giving that bar a save toast is outside this card; noted in the body.
- **Not measured live against a hook that sets `onNotice`** - the server half for sandboxed and flow hooks is #28251; the chain is pinned through the real adapter and the real save paths in jsdom, with three ablations shown red. Acceptable for the console half; the live measure belongs with #28251.
- **Serial overlap** - none on `main` today; `writeWarningToast.ts` and `record-save-feedback.ts` were last moved by #28261 / #28267, both already in the merge-base.
- **No name approval owed** - `notice` was ruled with #28000 and PR #28247.

### ④ Design judgment

- **Nothing blocking, and no should-fix on the diff.** Tried: a notice with an empty string (dropped at the adapter); a notice-only answer on a claimed write (success variant with a description, pinned); notice beside warnings, claimed and unclaimed (warning variant, notice first, pinned both ways); two rows in "Save All" sharing a notice (shown once); a grid write the grid did not make while a row claim is open (the claim's scope names a different id, so the channel toasts, pinned as CONTROL); a thrown row save (the `finally` releases the claim and whatever it parked goes to the channel). Putting the notice on the existing claim rather than a second channel is the right shape: it is the mechanism #28216 built for exactly this one-toast rule.

**Verdict reasoning.** The adapter reads the key exactly as the spec declares it; the notice rides the claim #28216 built, so every save surface the card names stays at one toast and an unclaimed write gets one from the channel; the grid's new claims are opened before the write and released in `finally`. The widening is declared and patch is right; the two reshaped signatures are unreleased and ship together. What remains is a live measure that belongs with the server half #28251.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-1iw5ln`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibw58ehQ2gRHP2h2Puz`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · seat `domain:ui#1` · head `4056fd97` · 2026-10-31T04:25Z

席位意见：服务器在单条记录写入的回答里带 `notice` 时，控制台现在会显示出来，而且每次保存仍只弹一个提示：notice 单独一行，放在警告上方；只有 notice 时保持成功样式。表单、抽屉、弹窗、记录页和表格的单行保存与「全部保存」都覆盖到了。没被任何保存流程认领的写入，由通道弹一个信息提示。旧版服务器的回答不带这个键，就什么也不多显示。已按扩面申报 `Clause-②: yes (widening)`。

1. **Shape:** `Fixes #28252`, draft, base `main`, 15 files, +701/−62. The adapter's `WriteWarningEvent` gains `notice` through `readWriteNotice`. `record-save-feedback.ts` gains `RecordSaveFeedback`, `take()` returns it, and `toastRecordSave` takes a `Partial` of it. The PR also touches `writeWarningToast.ts`, `AppContent.tsx`, `RecordFormPage.tsx` and `ObjectFormContainer.tsx`, and `ObjectGrid.tsx` is the surface addition accepted in claim amendment 6538826704.
2. **Seat read:** the two reshaped `@object-ui/react` signatures are still unreleased at this landing. `.changeset/28216-form-container-one-save-toast.md` is still on `origin/main` at 2026-10-31T04:25Z, and the published `@object-ui/react` is `18.2.0`. So the lane's condition holds, and this lands before any Version Packages release. The grid's claims open before the write and are released in `finally`.
3. **Contract review:** PASS at this head, record 6538972595 (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`), by the contract-review lane, not the drafter. No should-fix. Its flags: the inline-edit Save bar has no save toast of its own, so its notice comes through the channel, which is still one toast. The live measure belongs with the server half #28251.
4. **Gates / check-runs:** on `4056fd97`: 45 success, 15 skipped, 0 failure. `mergeable_state` clean.
5. **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --pr 28307` reports NOT governed, 763 changed lines ≤ 3000. The seat readies the PR and arms auto-merge, on the maintainer's 「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」 (seat thread, 2026-10-30T14:19Z).
